pool.staff_mittel_verstaerkung.a.a11: If I knew where to print money for the staff I'd long be chairman. I'll try the normal route.

pool.staff_mittel_verstaerkung.a.a12: After the defeats everyone is short of patience, me included. Your wish is understandable and I'll take it along.

pool.staff_mittel_verstaerkung.a.a13: More personnel isn't planned at present, and I consider your equipment sufficient.
